name: codex-cost-tracker
description: Read-only Codex desktop and CLI token-value estimates, separate from actual API charges and credit balances.

interface.shortDescription: Estimate Codex token costs with explicit billing uncertainty.
interface.longDescription: Read native Codex usage records for task and daily token-value estimates. Show incomplete coverage and unknown budgets without mixing in Claude Code or Joyia billing.
interface.defaultPrompt: Report this task's estimated token value and today's local Codex usage. Separate estimates from actual charges and account credits.
